name: Toast
description: Toast notifications: SToastContainer renders the stack, useToast()/toast.* triggers them.
example:
<s-toast-container />

import { useToast } from '@kundancool/simple-ui'
const { success, error } = useToast()
success('Order confirmed')

// anywhere, no setup needed:
import { toast } from '@kundancool/simple-ui'
toast.error('Payment failed')
